sentences.text: South Australia’s Independent Commissioner Against Corruption examined how the COVID-19 pandemic could affect integrity in public administration.
sentences.section: PUBLIC ADMINISTRATION IN A PANDEMIC: UNIQUE CHALLENGES IN THE CURRENT CLIMATE
sentences.support:
this report should focus on how the pandemic might impact upon integrity 
in public administration in South Australia.

sentences.text: The Commissioner identified risks involving remote supervision, information security, procurement, contract management and pressure on public officers.
sentences.support:
Procurement, contract 
management and information management are some such prominent risk areas 
that are likely to come under increased pressure.

sentences.text: The Commissioner warned that disruption, economic uncertainty and reduced oversight could increase opportunities for improper conduct.
sentences.section: Integrity in Public Administration in Light of COVID-19
sentences.support:
It is important to be mindful that during times of significant disruption and 
economic uncertainty, corruption and inappropriate conduct can become 
more prevalent.

sentences.text: The Commissioner urged agencies to review contingency arrangements, maintain expenditure oversight, protect information and support staff experiencing difficulties.
sentences.support:
agencies should ensure that all 
procurements and expenditure remains the subject of appropriate oversight

findings.quote:
Remote working arrangements also pose significant risks around information 
and cyber security.

notes: No separate executive summary or equivalent synopsis is provided. The report offers preventive advice without a numbered recommendations list.
